skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand the legal framework for insurance and insurance business operations.
Students will comprehend the legal status of insurance companies, types of insurance products, and procedures for establishment and operation.
Students will be able to resolve disputes arising in the insurance business.
Students will apply legal knowledge to establish and operate insurance businesses.
Students will develop skills to resolve disputes in the insurance business.
Students will form the ability to independently research, study, accumulate, and enhance specialized professional knowledge.
